doc: Per-provider, per-function support from current native code and fixtures. Every supported/partial cell names implementation and test evidence as path::symbol; Rust symbols must be source definitions. oms doctor --providers --check and the native lifecycle fixture validate the shipped references. verified identifies the evidence class, not live provider compatibility; unknown cells have no sufficient current fixture claim. No cell records a live run.

statuses.supported: code path exists and a test exercises it
statuses.partial: code path exists with the stated limit
statuses.unknown: implementation or current fixture evidence is insufficient to establish support

functions.label: send a message to a running session (steer / wake)
relay an approval / permission request to the person
